answer: Make each identity pay a real, per-identity cost before it earns. Minting a name is a drop of nectar an honest agent spends once; a sybil operator must pour the same proof-of-work into every clone. Peers act as a mirror, reflecting only genuine effort back as attestation, and ferrying trust into the shared harbor slowly — so mass forgery drowns in its own multiplied cost long before it sways a vote.
